lcc_original: 水又不斷地消減、直到十月；十月初一日、山頂都現出來了。
notes: H2320+H6224 were implicit {braces} in UNV (first 'tenth month' unmarked in UNV's collapsing of עַד הַחֹדֶשׁ הָעֲשִׂירִי), but LCC explicitly writes 十月 for that first occurrence — Rule 3 applied: braces dropped and SNs attached directly to 十月.
H1961 (הָיוּ = were) remains implicit after 又 — LCC also has no explicit copula, same as UNV.

H1980 (הָלוֹךְ = going/walking, expressing the progressive-continuous aspect of the verbal hendiadys הָלוֹךְ וְחָסוֹר) mapped to LCC 不斷地 (continually/without stopping), while H2637 (חָסוֹר = diminish) maps to 消減.
